niche_preference_profile: This user prefers interfaces that feel complete, readable, and well-structured: light or airy rather than dark/heavy, with clear section hierarchy, balanced use of space, and enough visible content to avoid empty or unfinished-looking screens. They like concise but explicit labels, prominent titles, and straightforward controls that are easy to scan. They generally favor modern, clean layouts with strong visual organization over sparse, vague, or cluttered presentations.

criteria.description: The user prefers screens that show a broader, more complete set of relevant settings or items, rather than sparse or incomplete-looking lists.
The user prefers interfaces with clearly separated, well-grouped sections and strong visual hierarchy between areas.
The user prefers layouts that feel evenly filled and visually balanced, avoiding large empty areas or top-heavy compositions.
The user prefers every row or control to have an explicit, readable text label and purpose, rather than blank, unlabeled, or unfinished-looking items.
The user prefers a clean, modern, minimalist presentation with simple surfaces, subtle separators, and low visual clutter.
The user prefers strong page titles and clear top-level hierarchy that make the screen immediately understandable.
